name: Intel 8085 Serial Hello
desc: Intel 8085 - Send 'Hello 8085' string to serial monitor using OUT 0FFH (serial output port).
code:
; Intel 8085 - Serial Hello World
; Output 'Hello 8085' to the serial monitor
; Each character sent by writing to port 0FFH

        LXI H, MSG       ; HL = pointer to message string

NEXT:   MOV A, M         ; Load next character
        CPI 00H          ; Check for null terminator
        JZ DONE          ; If null, we are done
        OUT 0FFH         ; Send character to serial port
        INX H            ; Next character
        JMP NEXT         ; Loop

DONE:   MVI A, 0DH       ; Send CR
        OUT 0FFH
        MVI A, 0AH       ; Send LF
        OUT 0FFH
        HLT              ; Stop CPU

MSG:    DB 48H, 65H, 6CH, 6CH, 6FH  ; 'Hello'
        DB 20H                      ; ' '
        DB 38H, 30H, 38H, 35H      ; '8085'
        DB 00H                      ; null terminator
